data.text:
A weekly breakdown of competitors' Telegram channels.

1) Put the channels into "Web search": @channel1, @channel2 (public, up to 5).
2) Run: fresh posts are pulled without any API (t.me/s/), a marketing analyst breaks down topics, hooks and the funnel, and the digest goes to Telegram.
3) Enable the schedule on the trigger — and the breakdown arrives by itself once a week.

If a channel is private or unreadable, the board says so honestly.

data.label: Marketing breakdown
data.prompt:
You are a marketing analyst. Below are fresh posts from competitors' Telegram channels. Write a short digest per channel: 1) the week's main topics; 2) what hooks/techniques they use in opening lines; 3) what they sell and how they lead to purchase (the funnel); 4) one idea worth borrowing. Rely ONLY on the texts below, invent nothing. If there are few posts — say so.

{{input}}
